summary: New Taipei's 2026 programme (環保局, motor.ntpc.gov.tw) pays mostly for scrapping an old scooter. Buying new with no scrapping: NT$4,000 for a heavy-class electric scooter, NT$2,000 for a light one (households on low or middle-low income: 14,000 / 12,000). Scrapping a scooter made by 2015 and buying electric: NT$8,000-10,000 heavy, NT$4,000-6,000 light, depending on the old scooter's emission period (low-income: +10,000). The NT$10,000 early-bird add-on sold out on 2026-10-29 (waitlist only). The NT$9,000 double-scrap add-on, which needs two old scooters scrapped together, had 187 of 1,000 slots left on 2026-11-25. The advertised NT$39,600 maximum (city + central, from TVBS) needs two scrapped scooters and every slot, so it is not typical. Payout is capped at the purchase price. You need to have lived in New Taipei at least one year, buy from a New Taipei dealer, and have never received a city subsidy. Stage 1 closes 2026-12-31, stage 2 on 2027-01-10. No 2027 plan has been published. No city parking, charging or licence perks were confirmed.
